newsitem.title: CHINA: China orders banks to limit power of branches.
newsitem.headline: China orders banks to limit power of branches.

text.p: China's central bank has issued new rules requiring Chinese commercial banks to set limits on the ability of their branches to act independently, the Shanghai Securities News said on Thursday.
The rules require the banks to set limits for their branches on making loans, doing discount business and offering guarantees, the newspaper said.

The banks are required to ensure that the branches strictly abide by the limits and thoroughly audit the branches' operations at least once a year to ensure they are complying with the rules, it said.
Any bank violating the rules will have their chiefs removed from office and those who violate the rules will be prosecuted, the newspaper said.
